title: Physiotherapy & rehabilitation
summary: Discuss the recovery support appropriate to your treatment.

blocks.text: Use these questions as a starting point for a conversation with your treating team.

sections.heading: Questions to ask your treating team

items: Will I need a rehabilitation or physiotherapy plan?
Who will provide the instructions that apply to me?
How will my progress and follow-up be reviewed?

blocks.text: Follow the individual instructions provided by your treating team.
